title: New Moon in Virgo
tldr: A seed point for routine, discernment, repair, health, craft, and the small actions that make devotion real.
theme: Virgo is a mutable earth sign ruled traditionally by Mercury. This New Moon begins work around routine, discernment, repair, health, craft, and the small actions that make devotion real.
shadow: perfectionism as self-harm, over-correcting yourself until there is no room to live
integration: building a humane structure that supports excellence without cruelty

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc asks where structure can set you free instead of becoming another way to attack yourself.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Virgo; watch what the Pisces Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Mercury kamea, yellow or white candle, agate or clear quartz, feather, water, and a list or journal page.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Virgo. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through routine, discernment, repair, health, craft, and the small actions that make devotion real, without repeating the shadow of perfectionism as self-harm, over-correcting yourself until there is no room to live?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Virgo intention take form?
